ui.thorax.title: Thorax
ui.thorax.completion: Realizacja liczy ile osiągnięć z Thorax zostało przez ciebie zdobyte.
ui.thorax.thank_you: Dobrze, Cześć! Dzięki za granie z Thorax i zrobienie wszystkiego! Paczka nie jest jeszcze zbyt duża, ale jestem szczęśliwy że w ogóle istnieje! Mam nadzieję zobaczyć cię znowu gdy wyjdzie więcej aktualiacji do Thorax!
ui.thorax.credits_text: Dziękuję wszystkim którzy pomagali w tworzeniu %s, To nie byłoby możliwe bez was!
item.thorax.scrapbook.description: Śledzi jakie robaki zostały już przez ciebie złapane.
item.thorax.cabbage_butterfly.descriptio: A common white butterfly with black spots. As larva, they feast upon leafy vegetables and switch to nectar as adults.
item.thorax.agrias_butterfly.description: A fast-flying butterfly that feasts upon rotting fruit and oher organics. Its striking coloration feigns that it is poisonous.
item.thorax.monarch_butterfly.descriptio: A rare butterfly known as the king of the insects. Their striking orange wings resembled the shining sun to the ancients.
item.thorax.blazing_daggerwing.descripti: Ancient butterflies stranded in the Nether managed to adapt by feeding on fungi and sheltering in glowstone.
item.thorax.arctic_apollo.description: In order to survive the harsh cold, they frequently enter a hibernation-like nap in tree cavities and caverns.
item.thorax.miller_moth.description: A mindless insect that's easily disoriented by light. Feeds upon plants and other fibers.
item.thorax.luna_moth.description: A dazzling moth that dances through the night. Their name comes from their striking beauty paired with a full moon.
item.thorax.caccophomoth.description: Completely blind dwellers of the depths that dance a thin line between surviving and subsisting off of sculk.
item.thorax.praying_mantis.description: A lethal hunter that hides among foliage before striking with deadly precision. To the ancients, they became emblems of nature.
item.thorax.orchid_mantis.description: Reclusive predators that hide among flowers. Their appearance and scent lure would-be prey.
item.thorax.ladybug.description: Small spotted beetles that prey on even smaller critters. Some say the more spots, the more lives they have lived.
item.thorax.walking_stick.description: A cryptic critter that watches from treetops, feasting upon leaves and hiding in plain sight.
item.thorax.walking_leaf.description: This creature is often mistaken for actual leaves by herbivorous insects, causing frequent injury.
item.thorax.green_darter.description: A common fast-flying insect that leverages its speed to catch prey.
item.thorax.azure_damselfly.description: Its striking blue color would appear to alert predators, but it's speed far outweighs that disadvantage.
item.thorax.crystal_dasher.description: Dragonflies stranded here adapted to eat chorus fruit, inheriting its unstable properties.
item.thorax.pond_skater.description: These insects leverage surface-tension to skim the water's surface.
item.thorax.sea_strider.description: The only known open-ocean insects that rely on stray organic matter to survive.
item.thorax.bark_scorpion.description: Versatile predators that ambush prey and inject them with a lethal toxin.
item.thorax.cathode_scorpion.description: An inexplicable mutation led to this scorpion developing the ability to store and inject electrical charge.
item.thorax.red_.description: Legend speaks of an elusive insect found deep in caverns, but no one has ever found such a thing.
